tag.featured.add.description: Button in the profile settings that adds a row for one more featured hashtag.

tag.featured.count.description: How many of an account's public and unlisted posts have a featured hashtag, on its profile, when none has a date.

tag.featured.description.defaultMessage: プロフィールにこの順で並べるハッシュタグです ({max} 個まで)。それぞれに、公開と未収載の投稿のうちそのタグの付いた数が出ます。
tag.featured.description.description: Description of the featured hashtags in the profile settings. {max} is the most, 10.

tag.featured.field.description: Label of the field of one featured hashtag in the profile settings. {number} is its place, 1 to 10.

tag.featured.move_down.defaultMessage: ハッシュタグ {number} を下へ
tag.featured.move_down.description: Icon button and its tooltip that moves a featured hashtag one place down. {number} is its place.

tag.featured.move_up.defaultMessage: ハッシュタグ {number} を上へ
tag.featured.move_up.description: Icon button and its tooltip that moves a featured hashtag one place up. {number} is its place.

tag.featured.moved.defaultMessage: {tag} を {position} 番目に動かしました。
tag.featured.moved.description: Announced once a featured hashtag moved. {tag} is the hashtag with its #; {position} its new place, from 1.

tag.featured.moved_empty.defaultMessage: 空のハッシュタグを {position} 番目に動かしました。
tag.featured.moved_empty.description: Announced once an empty row of the featured hashtags moved. {position} is its new place, from 1.

tag.featured.remove.defaultMessage: ハッシュタグ {number} を外す
tag.featured.remove.description: Button in the profile settings that removes one featured hashtag. {number} is its place.

tag.featured.save_failed.defaultMessage: 注目のハッシュタグを保存できませんでした: {reason}
tag.featured.save_failed.description: Result of saving the profile settings when the featured hashtags were not saved. {reason} says why.

tag.featured.stats.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {投稿 # 件}}、最後は {date}
tag.featured.stats.description: How many of an account's public and unlisted posts have a featured hashtag, and when one last had it, on its profile. {date} is a formatted date.

tag.featured.title.description: Heading of the hashtags a profile features, on the profile and in the profile settings.

tag.featured.too_many.defaultMessage: 注目のハッシュタグは {max} 個までです。
tag.featured.too_many.description: Result of saving the profile settings with too many featured hashtags. {max} is the most, 10.

tag.follow.description: Button on a hashtag's page that follows the hashtag, so that its posts join the user's home timeline.

tag.follow.description.defaultMessage: フォローすると、フォローしていない人の公開の投稿もホームに入ります。
tag.follow.description.description: Sentence under the follow button of a hashtag's page, saying what following the hashtag does.

tag.follow.failed.defaultMessage: {tag} のフォローを変更できませんでした: {reason}
tag.follow.failed.description: Toast when following or unfollowing a hashtag failed. {tag} is the hashtag with its #; {reason} says why.

tag.follow.too_many.defaultMessage: フォローできるハッシュタグは {max} 個までです。ほかのものをフォローするには、どれかのフォローをやめてください。
tag.follow.too_many.description: Shown when the user follows the most hashtags allowed. {max} is that number, 100.

tag.followed.description: Announced, and shown above the list of followed hashtags, once the user followed a hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag with its #, for example '#cats'.

tag.followed_list.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {フォローしているハッシュタグ {max} 個中 # 個}}
tag.followed_list.count.description: What the count beside the list of followed hashtags means, read aloud. {count} is how many the user follows; {max} is the most they can, 100.

tag.followed_list.description.defaultMessage: これらのハッシュタグの付いた公開の投稿は、フォローしていない人のものもホームに入ります。ブーストは入りません。
tag.followed_list.description.description: Description of the list of followed hashtags in the settings.

tag.followed_list.empty.defaultMessage: フォローしているハッシュタグはありません
tag.followed_list.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of followed hashtags.

tag.followed_list.empty.description.defaultMessage: ここか、ハッシュタグのページでフォローすると、その投稿がホームに入ります。
tag.followed_list.empty.description.description: Sentence of the empty list of followed hashtags, which leads to following one.

tag.followed_list.follow.description: Button that submits the form that follows a hashtag, in the settings.

tag.followed_list.follow_failed.defaultMessage: ハッシュタグをフォローできませんでした: {reason}
tag.followed_list.follow_failed.description: Error of the form that follows a hashtag. {reason} says why.

tag.followed_list.list.title.defaultMessage: フォローしているハッシュタグ
tag.followed_list.list.title.description: Heading of the list of the hashtags the user follows, in the settings.

tag.followed_list.new.title.defaultMessage: ハッシュタグをフォロー
tag.followed_list.new.title.description: Button that opens the form that follows a hashtag, and the title of that form, in the settings.

tag.followed_list.since.description: When the user followed a hashtag, on its row in the settings. {date} is a formatted date.

tag.followed_list.title.defaultMessage: フォローしたハッシュタグ
tag.followed_list.title.description: Title of the settings page and menu item that lists the hashtags the user follows.

tag.followed_list.unfollow.description: Button on a row of the list of followed hashtags that unfollows the hashtag.

tag.followed_list.unfollow_failed.defaultMessage: {tag} のフォローをやめられませんでした: {reason}
tag.followed_list.unfollow_failed.description: Shown above the list of followed hashtags when unfollowing one failed. {tag} is the hashtag with its #; {reason} says why.

tag.followed_mark.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {フォロー中のハッシュタグ}} {tags}
tag.followed_mark.description: Line above a post on the home timeline that is there only because it has a hashtag the user follows, from someone the user does not follow. {tags} is the hashtags with their #, as links, for example '#cats' or '#cats and #dogs'; {count} is how many.

tag.following.description: Button on a hashtag's page while the user follows the hashtag; pressing it unfollows the hashtag.

tag.name.description: Label of the field where the user types a hashtag to follow.

tag.name.description.defaultMessage: # は付けても付けなくてもかまいません (#パン など)。文字・数字・_ が使えます。
tag.name.description.description: Help under the field where the user types a hashtag.

tag.name.invalid.defaultMessage: ハッシュタグには文字・数字・_ だけが使え、文字を 1 つ以上含みます。
tag.name.invalid.description: Error of a hashtag field when the text is not a hashtag.

tag.name.required.defaultMessage: ハッシュタグを入力してください。
tag.name.required.description: Error of the hashtag field when it is empty.

tag.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the posts of one hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #, for example 'cats'.

tag.unfollowed.defaultMessage: {tag} のフォローをやめました。
tag.unfollowed.description: Announced once the user unfollowed a hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag with its #, for example '#cats'.
